behaviors.behavior: After the final compiled code is produced, profile the DNN model to obtain authentic performance metrics including memory consumption and inference latency.
behaviors.precondition: Final compiled code is available; profiling is performed on the compiled model.

evidence.quote: model designers can proﬁle the DNN model to obtain authentic performance met-rics, including memory consumption and inference latency.

behaviors.behavior: Given profiling feedback, update the sparsity attributes in some (a subset of) tensors.
behaviors.precondition: Profiling feedback from a prior compiled model is available; designers choose which tensors' sparsity attributes to update.

evidence.quote: Given the feedback, model designers may further update the sparsity attributes in some tensors

behaviors.behavior: After updating sparsity attributes, repeat the compile-and-profile process iteratively to find the best tradeoff.
behaviors.precondition: Sparsity attributes have been updated by the designer.

evidence.quote: repeat this process iteratively to ﬁnd the best tradeoff

behaviors.behavior: Use real measured latency, rather than FLOPs, as the metric to filter candidate models during sparsity exploration.
behaviors.precondition: Candidate sparse models can be compiled and profiled to obtain real latency; used in a pruning search (e.g., Simulated Annealing).

evidence.quote: SparTA uses the real latency to filter models.

behaviors.behavior: Accelerate the fine-tuning step of an iterative sparsity search by using high-performance sparse kernels, reducing total exploration time.
behaviors.precondition: Sparsity algorithm iteratively sparsifies a proportion of the model and fine-tunes each iteration; SparTA sparse kernels are used for fine-tuning.

evidence.quote: With SparTA, model ﬁne-tuning can be accelerated.

behaviors.behavior: Iterate the compilation process itself for further improvement.
behaviors.precondition: A compilation pass has produced output that can be re-fed into compilation.

evidence.quote: This process may be iterated for further improvement.

behaviors.behavior: Use the feedback loop to evaluate sparsity proposals end-to-end, thereby facilitating innovation in model sparsity.
behaviors.precondition: The loop is used to evaluate sparsity proposals end-to-end.
search_terms: facilitating the innovation in model sparsity

evidence.quote: Thus SparTA enables a feedback loop, facilitating the innovation in model sparsity.

behaviors.behavior: In the FLOPS-based baseline, filter out candidate models whose FLOPS is larger than 70% of the original model's FLOPS.
behaviors.precondition: Baseline comparison mode using FLOPS as the metric is selected.

evidence.quote: Our baseline uses FLOPS as the metric to ﬁlter out the disqualiﬁed models: the model whose FLOPS is larger than 70% of the original FLOPS.

behaviors.behavior: Repeat the sparsify-and-fine-tune iteration until the targeted sparsity (e.g., 90%) is achieved.
behaviors.precondition: A target sparsity level has been set.
search_terms: repeats the iteration until achieving the targeted sparsity

evidence.quote: It repeats the iteration until achieving the targeted sparsity (e.g., 90%).

changes.reason: 该行把“更新部分张量稀疏属性”和“迭代重复编译/剖析以找最佳权衡”两个可独立证伪的动作合并，需拆分以分别对应 O3 与 O4。
